entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shouldn't you be heading to volleyball?
entries.uk: Хіба тобі не треба на волейбол?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That bruise above your eye...[n]Is that from practice, too?
entries.uk: Той синець над оком...[n]Теж із тренування?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you sure you're not pushing yourself[n]too hard?

entries.speaker: Shiho
entries.en: I'm okay... Volleyball's the only thing[n]I can do right...
entries.uk: Я в порядку... Волейбол — єдине,[n]що в мене виходить...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's probably just my part-time job...[n]I think.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Today won't work... I'm...[n]I'm not feeling so good...
entries.uk: Сьогодні не вийде... Я...[n]я погано почуваюся...

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Student
entries.en: Rumor has it she's dating Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Student
entries.en: I heard people saw them in his car[n]together.
entries.uk: Я чув, їх бачили разом у його[n]машині.

entries.speaker: Bored Male Student
entries.en: You know... she seems pretty easy, huh?[n]You think I'd have a chance, too?
entries.uk: Знаєш... вона, здається, доступна, га?[n]Думаєш, і мені б перепало?

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Student
entries.en: C'mon, dude, you can't go after[n]Kamoshida's bitch!
